invariants.rationale: The method returns an instance of HoodieWriteMetadata; it's likely that it should never return null.
The returned metadata should contain a non-null list of WriteStatus as part of the contract.
A list's size is always non-negative; this holds unless null, which is covered above.
If any input records are supplied, the write should produce at least one WriteStatus; if input is empty, size could be zero.
If partition-to-write stats are provided, they should not be empty if there was work done.
